description: You are a high school geometry teacher creating an interactive proof demonstration for the SAS Triangle Similarity Theorem (Common Core Standard G-SRT.5). Create a GeoGebra construction where: (1) Triangle ABC has vertices A at the origin (0, 0), B at (4, 0), and C at (2, 3). (2) Using GeoGebra's Dilate (dilation transformation) tool, create triangle A'B'C' as a dilation of triangle ABC with scale factor 1.5 centered at the origin. (3) Display the measurements of all six side lengths and verify numerically that the ratios A'B'/AB, B'C'/BC, and A'C'/AC are all equal to 1.5. (4) Add a text element that states the scale factor and explicitly verifies the similarity relationship. Save as 'triangle_similarity.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
